FC Košice avizuje prvú ligu do piatich rokov] June 21, 2018 | manager = [[Peter Černák]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = [[Slovak First Football League]] | season = [[2025–26 Slovak First Football League|2025–26]] | position = Slovak First Football League, 7th of 12 | website = http://www.fckosice.sk/ | pattern_la1 = _kosice2627h | pattern_b1 = _kosice2627h | pattern_ra1 = _kosice2627h | pattern_sh1 = _kosice2627h | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_blue | leftarm1 = FFF200 | body1 = FFF200 | rightarm1 = FFF200 | shorts1 = FFF200 | socks1 = FFF200 | pattern_la2 = _kosice2627a | pattern_b2 = _kosice2627a | pattern_ra2 = _kosice2627a | pattern_sh2 = _kosice2627a | pattern_so2 = _3_stripes_yellow | leftarm2 = 0000DD | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFF200 | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''FC Košice''' is a [[Slovakia|Slovak]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Košice]], that currently plays in the [[Slovak First Football League]], the highest tier of Slovak football. FC Košice was founded in 2018. They merged into a new club with [[FK Košice-Barca]]. From a historical and traditional point of view, the club follows the first football club from Košice, Kassai Athletikai Club from 1903, later known as [[FC VSS Košice]], but from a legal point of view it is a new club with a clean slate.{{Cite web | url = http://www.futbalvsfz.sk/adresar_2010_00.pdf | title = Adresár klubov súťažný ročník 2010/2011 | access-date = 2011-03-27 | date = 2011-03-27 | publisher = website FUTBALVSFZ.SK | language = sk }}{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}"}}
